theme.title: Rotation: Growth → Value & Defensives
theme.summary: Consumer Staples (+1.37%) and Communication Svcs (+0.98%) led the market today, while Technology (-2.61%) and Materials (-0.68%) brought up the rear. That split lines up with a rotation out of growth: growth-oriented sectors averaged -0.68% versus +0.68% for defensives and +0.10% for value and cyclicals, suggesting money moved from high-multiple names into steadier, cash-generative businesses. Major indices moved in a tighter band — S&P 500 -0.40%, Dow +0.10%, Nasdaq -0.90% — without one clearly dominating. Small caps moved roughly in line with the broader market, with the Russell 2000 at -0.32%. The VIX rose 3.26% to 19.30, pointing to a bit more caution creeping in beneath the surface. Gold slipped 0.75% to $3,887.60, crude oil was little changed at $88.92, and bitcoin gained 0.43% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
